# Aptli

> Aptli is a revenue assurance platform for hotels that reconciles OTA commissions, OTA virtual cards and CLC direct-bill payments against the PMS, proves each discrepancy with evidence, and performs the recovery action with the hotel's approval.

Aptli works as one daily sequence of three services:

1. Reconciliation (Reconcile): matches each reservation across OTA extranets, virtual cards, the CLC portal and the PMS, and flags where records disagree.
2. Finance Truth Engine (Prove): classifies each finding, attaches OTA and PMS evidence, excludes authorized exceptions, and tracks the amount from suspected to verified cash.
3. Automation Action (Act): files disputes and stay updates, charges eligible virtual cards, syncs CLC check-ins and posts payments, under rules set per property.

Every action has one of four states: taken care of, needs approval, your team's task, or blocked. Money counts as recovered only when it is received.

Primary market: US hotels, especially select-service and extended-stay properties, owners and management companies.

## Pages

- [Home](https://aptli.ai/): what Aptli is and how it works
- [Free leakage review](https://aptli.ai/contact/): a free, no-obligation review of one property's OTA commissions, OTA virtual cards and CLC direct-bill payments against the PMS, with the evidence for every finding. Read-only access, only the last four digits of a card are stored.
